title: The augmented van Trees inequality
summary: We introduce an augmented form of the van Trees inequality, that yields uniformly tighter lower bounds on the minimax squared Bayes risk of estimators compared with the classical van Trees inequality. Our augmented inequality also accommodates prior distributions whose densities need not vanish at the boundaries of their supports.
